name: Calendar
descriptor: A month grid over one date field. Six rows, seven columns, Monday first, and a cell per day.
verify_checks: calendar: the month maths is emitted
pros: time is the axis people already think in
an empty day is a fact you can see, not one you have to compute
clicking a day opens the form with the date filled in
the grid is computed in UTC, so it cannot drift across a timezone
cons: no times of day: one date field, one cell
no recurring entries, no multi-day spans
two entries a day is the most a cell shows before it says '+N more'
a phone gets a cramped month; the list is the better view there
best_for: one thing per day, seen across a month
avoid_if: entries have times, durations, or spans across days
